summary: Retest of the unlike/undo-like feature after E1's FeedCard.js fix. All primary frontend flows PASS. verified_scenarios: Compile: FeedCard.js compiles; no CRA red overlay; app loads to feed for demo-00.
Card 0 initial: like button = red gradient enabled (bg linear-gradient(#FF6B6B,#FF3D3D), disabled=null).

Click like on card 0 → toast fires (Liked or match), card state flips: bg becomes rgba(255,255,255,0.15), disabled attribute present, gray heart color. 'Liked ✕' pill (feed-prior-action-badge) appears top-right of card 0.
Card 1 isolation: while card 0 is liked, card 1's like button remains red gradient + enabled (disabled=null). Per-video state confirmed.

Undo: click Liked pill → 'Like removed' toast (also emits 'Match saved' toast from prior match), pill disappears, like button restored to red gradient enabled, position counter stays 1/12 (no auto-advance).
Cleanup: pre-cleanup pass unliked any leftover 'Liked' badges from previous demo-00 runs before the test began.
critical_code_review_comments: FeedCard.js FeedCard() component (lines 244-272) — ternary on item.prior_action==='like' now correctly wired. Gray disabled variant uses bg rgba(255,255,255,0.15), boxShadow none, disabled attribute, heart tinted rgba(255,255,255,0.45). Matches spec.
FeedScreen.handleUnlike (lines 163-175) properly optimistic-updates prior_action to null and rolls back on API failure. No auto-advance path invoked. Good.
Minor: 24+ 404s on network resources in browser console (asset requests). Not blocking. Recommend E1 audit the missing static assets when convenient.
